basis: Calibrated raw-unit table in the skill's modules/vital/README.md (measured on Vital 1.0.7 AU renders): unison_detune = cents/17.5 (17.5 cents between two voices per unit, linear); volume interpolated in log(value) between 5473 = 0 dB (default) and 4400 = -7.65 dB, so -6 dB = 4612; reverb_decay_time = log2(seconds); delay_frequency (sync off) = log2(1/seconds); osc_1_tune in semitones, so +25 cents = 0.25.
